findings.description: This bucket is explicitly noted as public with no ACL restricting access, and has no server-side encryption configured, meaning any object stored (including the customer-master.xlsx uploaded to it) can potentially be read by unauthenticated users and is stored unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects are stored without encryption at rest, risking data exposure if underlying storage is compromised.
A customer master data file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket, which is public and unencrypted, exposing potentially sensitive customer data to unauthorized access.
The financials bucket, likely containing sensitive financial data, has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving data unencrypted at rest.
The operations bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest.
The data_science bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration block, leaving stored data unencrypted at rest despite likely containing sensitive analytical data.
